sources.title: AWS CloudTrail StopLogging API
sources.method_note: Match a StopLogging event as a review lead; it does not establish that the actor was unauthorized or that other logging stopped.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-61r3
sources.method_note: Use the operational investigation context; this exact matching rule is an illustrative implementation and is not a NIST-validated detection.

rules.claim: Trail logging was requested to stop; verify authorization, success, and the resulting evidence coverage.
